text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels satisfying, but taking profits too quickly can leave substantial further gains on the table; I should avoid selling just because a position is in profit.","My frequent partial sales have not prevented my account value from falling, so I should judge decisions by the whole portfolio rather than each realized gain.","Past price moves do not predict future returns, so I should base each trade on my plan and current circumstances—not chase recent rises or hold a losing position merely to avoid realizing pain."]}
